name: exampass
title_zh: 章节知识清单带原PPT对照，测完才放你走
tagline_zh: 期末周把PPT/Word/PDF喂进去，出来的是按章节排好的知识清单+原PPT对照+自测答案+交互测试。
tagline_en: Feed it your course slides and docs, get chapter-wise study maps with original slide references, answer keys, and.
desc_en: 将课程资料（PPT/Word/PDF）按章节生成知识清单+原始PPT对照+自测答案+交互式章节测试，帮助高效期末复习。
why_zh: 不是简单摘要——每章知识清单都锚定原始PPT页码，自测题按清单逐条生成，答错会回到对应PPT片段重看。
why_en: Not just summaries—each chapter map is anchored to original slide pages, and quiz questions link back to the exact slide segment.
limit_zh: 只吃文本型课程资料（PPT/Word/PDF），扫描版或纯图片需先OCR；产出到章节测试为止，不做错题本。
limit_en: Text-based course files only (PPT/Word/PDF); scanned/image-only PDFs need OCR first. Output ends at chapter quizzes—no error log or study planner.
title_en: Chapter knowledge maps with slide-by-slide self-tests
